intro: The Final Clue to Sanders' Treasure is a whiskey-stained note found stuffed inside an old jug on the Westfall coast. It provides the concluding directions left behind by the deceased pirate Captain Sanders, guiding scavengers straight into the open sea to recover his buried booty.

p: Reeling from a heavy stench of spirits, this smudged parchment marks the end of Captain Sanders' convoluted paper trail across Westfall. The late buccaneer, known for leaving cryptic directions across the shoreline, hid his final note deep inside an old whiskey jug along the coast. The instructions are crude yet straightforward: head due west into the ocean waves from the location of the bottle, braving the cold surf until reaching a lonely offshore rock where his ironbound sea chest lies waiting.
